claims: Bill Murray was born in Evanston, Illinois, on September 21, 1950.
Bill Murray grew up in the Chicago suburb of Wilmette, Illinois.
Bill Murray was one of nine children in an Irish Catholic family.
Bill Murray attended St. Joseph's grade school.
Loyola Academy is an all-boys Jesuit private school in Wilmette.
Bill Murray worked as a golf caddy to fund his education.
Bill Murray was the lead singer of a rock band called the Dutch Masters.
Bill Murray began his comedic career at Chicago's Second City improvisational comedy troupe.
Bill Murray's brothers Brian Doyle-Murray, Joel Murray, and John Murray are also actors
